original_evidence_immutable.mechanism: SQLite triggers and schema composite foreign keys prevent UPDATE/DELETE on captured evidence rows.

cross_task_evidence_rejected.mechanism: EvidenceResolver verifies task_id matches active task scope; mismatched task_ids raise CrossTaskEvidenceError.

fabricated_evidence_rejected.mechanism: Evidence snapshot candidate validation confirms physical existence in SQLite before allowing reference.

analyst_note_cannot_become_evidence.mechanism: Analyst notes are typed as context-only annotations; EvidenceResolver rejects non-(task_id, evidence_key) structures.

hypothesis_cannot_become_accepted_fact_a.mechanism: StateTransitionPolicy restricts hypothesis actions to scratch/hypothesis scope; promoting to canonical fact requires explicit analyst review authority.

unsupported_question_closure_rejected.mechanism: Question closure requires positive grounded evidence or explicit inconclusive/unavailable disposition with documented limitations.

stale_working_state_rejected.mechanism: Optimistic concurrency locking requires matching expected_state_revision; revision mismatch halts with WorkingStateRevisionConflictError.

finalization_gate_not_equal_analyst_acce.mechanism: FinalizationGate evaluates operational run termination; it does not grant analyst approval to unverified claims.

report_evidence_admission_independent.mechanism: Report evidence table maintains independent lifecycle from agent working state; additions require explicit user or report API call.

historical_analysis_versions_preserved.mechanism: Secondary analysis rows are append-only with monotonically increasing version numbers; old revisions remain queryable.

model_semantic_failure.definition: The model proposes an illogical, overassertive, or ungrounded claim in natural language.
model_semantic_failure.system_response: Penalized under semantic evaluation; does NOT compromise system integrity.

deterministic_policy_rejection.definition: StateTransitionPolicy, MergeGuard, or Validator rejects the model proposal before state mutation.
deterministic_policy_rejection.system_response: Action blocked; rejection reason logged to agent_trajectory_events; working state revision unchanged.

unauthorized_state_commit.definition: An illegal mutation bypasses deterministic gates and alters canonical database state.
unauthorized_state_commit.system_response: System safety breach (Tier A hard stop). Observed count across all runs = 0.
